vectors.name: CRLF becomes LF, trailing spaces and tabs leave each line, and extra final newlines go
a lone CR becomes LF
CRLF becomes one LF, not two
NFD becomes NFC
trailing spaces and tabs leave every line, inner ones stay
a trailing NBSP stays
a space or tab before U+2028 or U+2029 stays: only LF ends a line
a space before a final U+2028 stays, and the text still ends in one LF
other trailing Unicode spaces stay
a missing final newline is added
several final newlines become one
leading blank lines and indentation stay
a Markdown hard break written as two trailing spaces goes, a backslash stays
blank text becomes the empty string
empty text stays empty
only newlines and carriage returns become the empty string
x is unchanged: the normalizer never touches markup
x only gains its final newline
a lone high surrogate becomes U+FFFD
a lone low surrogate becomes U+FFFD
a surrogate pair stays whole
a lone surrogate at the very end becomes U+FFFD before the final newline
